trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and state the purpose of the outbound call.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी LD-1010 inquiry बद्दल बोलत आहे. आम्ही तुमची उद्याची site visit confirm करण्यासाठी call केला आहे. मी account holder सोबत बोलत आहे का?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity but express time pressure.
steps.text: हो, मी बोलतोय. पण माझ्याकडे वेळ कमी आहे, लवकर सांगा.
steps.clean_text: हो, मी बोलतोय. पण माझ्याकडे वेळ कमी आहे, लवकर सांगा.
steps.model_visible_text: हो, मी बोलतोय. पण माझ्याकडे वेळ कमी आहे, लवकर सांगा.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the hurry and ask for a verification factor.
steps.text: नक्कीच sir. Verification साठी, तुमचा registered pincode सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factor.
steps.text: Pincode four one one zero four five आहे.
steps.clean_text: Pincode four one one zero four five आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: Pincode four one one zero four five आहे.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
Return the verification outcome.
Acknowledge successful verification and transition to looking up lead details.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. मी तुमची lead details check करतो, एक second द्या.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the lead's budget and configuration preferences.
Return the lead details.
Confirm the customer's configuration preference based on the lead lookup.
steps.text: तुमची requirement 3BHK साठी Bengaluru मध्ये आहे, बरोबर?

steps.purpose: Confirm requirement and urgently ask for project details.
steps.text: हो. मला Whitefield project बद्दल सांगा. त्याची price आणि possession कधी आहे? मला लवकर meeting ला जायचं आहे.
steps.clean_text: हो. मला Whitefield project बद्दल सांगा. त्याची price आणि possession कधी आहे? मला लवकर meeting ला जायचं आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: हो. मला Whitefield project बद्दल सांगा. त्याची price आणि possession कधी आहे? मला लवकर meeting ला जायचं आहे.

steps.purpose: Ask the customer to hold while checking inventory.
steps.text: मी Whitefield project ची inventory check करतो. एक minute line वर राहा.

steps.purpose: Check inventory for the requested project and configuration.
Return inventory details with missing price and possession data.
Handle incomplete tool response by stating what is available and refusing to invent missing details.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must read out the RERA ID but explicitly state that price and possession are missing, without inventing them.
steps.text: Sir, system मध्ये Whitefield project ची RERA ID PR/KN/1234 दिसत आहे, पण price आणि possession details सध्या available नाहीत. मी चुकीची माहिती देऊ शकत नाही.
steps.planner_rationale: Adhering to BR_RE_01 and BR_RE_03 by providing the RERA ID but not hallucinating the missing price and possession.

steps.purpose: Accept the situation and ask to schedule the visit, with an STT error.
steps.text: ठीक आहे. मला उद्या दुपारी flight पकडायची आहे, त्यामुळे morning ला लवकर visit ठेवा.
steps.clean_text: ठीक आहे. मला उद्या दुपारी flight पकडायची आहे, त्यामुळे morning ला लवकर visit ठेवा.
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक आहे. मला उद्या दुपारी flat पकडायची आहे, त्यामुळे morning ला लवकर visit ठेवा.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request to schedule the visit.
steps.text: नक्कीच. उद्या morning साठी मी तुमची visit schedule करतो.

steps.purpose: Schedule the site visit for tomorrow morning.
Return the scheduled visit details.
Confirm the site visit scheduling with the reference and executive name.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent grounds the confirmation entirely on the tool result, providing the reference and executive name.
steps.text: तुमची visit उद्या morning साठी schedule झाली आहे. Executive Amit तुम्हाला भेटेल. Reference number VR-456 आहे. Safe travels sir.
steps.planner_rationale: Concluding the transaction successfully by relaying the scheduled visit details accurately.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the confirmation and end the call.

ir.terminal_condition: Site visit scheduled with a reference, an executive and a slot.
